texts.NIV84: Woe to you, O destroyer, you who have not been destroyed! Woe to you, O traitor, you who have not been betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed; when you stop betraying, you will be betrayed.
texts.KJV: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
texts.DRB: WOE to thee that spoilest, shalt not thou thyself also be spoiled? and thou that despisest, shalt not thyself also be despised? when thou shalt have made an end of spoiling, thou shalt be spoiled: when being wearied thou shalt cease to despise, thou shalt be despised.
texts.ESV:
Ah, you destroyer,
    who yourself have not been destroyed,
you traitor,
    whom none has betrayed!
When you have ceased to destroy,
    you will be destroyed;
and when you have finished betraying,
    they will betray you.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, be gracious to us; we long for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of distress.
texts.KJV: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, be gracious to us; we have waited for You.
Be their strength every morning,
Our salvation also in the time of distress.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, be gracious to us;
We have waited for You.
Be their arm every morning,
Our salvation also in the time of trouble.
texts.DRB: O Lord, have mercy on us: for we have waited for thee: be thou our arm in the morning, and our salvation in the time of trouble.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, be gracious to us; we wait for you.
    Be our arm every morning,
    our salvation in the time of trouble.

texts.NIV84: At the thunder of your voice, the peoples flee; when you rise up, the nations scatter.
texts.KJV: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
texts.NASB95:
At the sound of the tumult peoples flee;
At the lifting up of Yourself nations disperse.
texts.NKJV:
At the noise of the tumult the people shall flee;
When You lift Yourself up, the nations shall be scattered;
texts.DRB: At the voice of the angel the people fled, and at the lifting up thyself the nations are scattered.
texts.ESV:
At the tumultuous noise peoples flee;
    when you lift yourself up, nations are scattered,

texts.NIV84: Your plunder, O nations, is harvested as by young locusts; like a swarm of locusts men pounce on it.
texts.KJV: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
texts.NASB95:
Your spoil is gathered as the caterpillar gathers;
As locusts rushing about men rush about on it.
texts.NKJV:
And Your plunder shall be gathered
Like the gathering of the caterpillar;
As the running to and fro of locusts,
He shall run upon them.
texts.DRB: And your spoils shall be gathered together as the locusts are gathered, as when the ditches are full of them.
texts.ESV:
and your spoil is gathered as the caterpillar gathers;
    as locusts leap, it is leapt upon.

texts.NIV84: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with justice and righteousness.
texts.KJV: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
texts.NASB95:
The Lord is exalted, for He dwells on high;
He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord is exalted, for He dwells on high;
He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
texts.DRB: The Lord is magnified, for he hath dwelt on high: he hath filled Sion with judgment and justice.
texts.ESV:
The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high;
    he will fill Zion with justice and righteousness,

texts.NIV84: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the LORD is the key to this treasure.
texts.KJV: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.
texts.DRB: And there shall be faith in thy times: riches of salvation, wisdom and knowledge: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.

texts.NIV84: Look, their brave men cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
texts.KJV: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, their brave men cry in the streets,
The ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
texts.NKJV:
Surely their valiant ones shall cry outside,
The ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
texts.DRB: Behold they that see shall cry without, the angels of peace shall weep bitterly.
texts.ESV:
Behold, their heroes cry in the streets;
    the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

texts.NIV84: The highways are deserted, no travelers are on the roads. The treaty is broken, its witnesses are despised, no one is respected.
texts.KJV: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
texts.NASB95:
The highways are desolate, the traveler has ceased,
He has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities,
He has no regard for man.
texts.NKJV:
The highways lie waste,
The traveling man ceases.
He has broken the covenant,
He has despised the cities,
He regards no man.
texts.DRB: The ways are made desolate, no one passeth by the road, the covenant is made void, he hath rejected the cities, he hath not regarded the men.

texts.NIV84: The land mourns and wastes away, Lebanon is ashamed and withers; Sharon is like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.
texts.KJV: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
texts.NASB95:
The land mourns and pines away,
Lebanon is shamed and withers;
Sharon is like a desert plain,
And Bashan and Carmel lose their foliage.
texts.NKJV:
The earth mourns and languishes,
Lebanon is shamed and shriveled;
Sharon is like a wilderness,
And Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
texts.DRB: The land hath mourned, and languished: Libanus is confounded and become foul, and Saron is become as a desert: and Basan and Carmel are shaken.

texts.NIV84: Look down from heaven and see from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.
texts.KJV: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
texts.NKJV:
Look down from heaven,
And see from Your habitation, holy and glorious.
Where are Your zeal and Your strength,
The yearning of Your heart and Your mercies toward me?
Are they restrained?
texts.DRB: Look down from heaven, and behold from thy holy habitation and the place of thy glory: where is thy zeal, and thy strength, the multitude of thy bowels, and of thy mercies? they have held back themselves from me.
texts.ESV:
Look down from heaven and see,
    from your holy and beautiful habitation.
Where are your zeal and your might?
    The stirring of your inner parts and your compassion
    are held back from me.

texts.NIV84: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.
texts.KJV: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
texts.NASB95:
For You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us
And Israel does not recognize us.
You, O Lord, are our Father,
Our Redeemer from of old is Your name.
texts.NKJV:
Doubtless You are our Father,
Though Abraham was ignorant of us,
And Israel does not acknowledge us.
You, O Lord, are our Father;
Our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
texts.DRB: For thou art our father, and Abraham hath not known us, and Israel hath been ignorant of us: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer, from everlasting is thy name.
texts.ESV:
For you are our Father,
    though Abraham does not know us,
    and Israel does not acknowledge us;
you, O Lord, are our Father,
    our Redeemer from of old is your name.

texts.NIV84: Why, O LORD, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.
texts.KJV: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
texts.NASB95:
Why, O Lord, do You cause us to stray from Your ways
And harden our heart from fearing You?
Return for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, why have You made us stray from Your ways,
And hardened our heart from Your fear?
Return for Your servants’ sake,
The tribes of Your inheritance.
texts.DRB: Why hast thou made us to err, O Lord, from thy ways: why hast thou hardened our heart, that we should not fear thee? return for the sake of thy servants, the tribes of thy inheritance.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, why do you make us wander from your ways
    and harden our heart, so that we fear you not?
Return for the sake of your servants,
    the tribes of your heritage.

texts.NIV84: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.
texts.KJV: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
texts.NASB95:
Your holy people possessed Your sanctuary for a little while,
Our adversaries have trodden it down.
texts.NKJV:
Your holy people have possessed it but a little while;
Our adversaries have trodden down Your sanctuary.
texts.DRB: They have possessed thy holy people as nothing: our enemies have trodden down thy sanctuary.
texts.ESV:
Your holy people held possession for a little while;
    our adversaries have trampled down your sanctuary.

texts.NIV84: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.
texts.KJV: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
texts.NASB95:
We have become like those over whom You have never ruled,
Like those who were not called by Your name.
texts.NKJV:
We have become like those of old, over whom You never ruled,
Those who were never called by Your name.
texts.DRB: We are become as in the beginning, when thou didst not rule over us, and when we were not called by thy name.
texts.ESV:
We have become like those over whom you have never ruled,
    like those who are not called by your name.

texts.NIV84: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!
texts.KJV: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
texts.NASB95:
Oh, that You would rend the heavens and come down,
That the mountains might quake at Your presence—
texts.NKJV:
Oh, that You would rend the heavens!
That You would come down!
That the mountains might shake at Your presence—
texts.DRB: THAT thou wouldst rend the heavens, and wouldst come down: the mountains would melt away at thy presence.
texts.ESV:
Oh that you would rend the heavens and come down,
    that the mountains might quake at your presence—

texts.NIV84: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!
texts.KJV: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
texts.NASB95:
As fire kindles the brushwood, as fire causes water to boil—
To make Your name known to Your adversaries,
That the nations may tremble at Your presence!
texts.NKJV:
As fire burns brushwood,
As fire causes water to boil—
To make Your name known to Your adversaries,
That the nations may tremble at Your presence!
texts.DRB: They would melt as at the burning of fire, the waters would burn with fire, that thy name might be made known to thy enemies: that the nations might tremble at thy presence.
texts.ESV:
as when fire kindles brushwood
    and the fire causes water to boil—
to make your name known to your adversaries,
    and that the nations might tremble at your presence!

texts.NIV84: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.
texts.KJV: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
texts.NASB95:
When You did awesome things which we did not expect,
You came down, the mountains quaked at Your presence.
texts.NKJV:
When You did awesome things for which we did not look,
You came down,
The mountains shook at Your presence.
texts.DRB: When thou shalt do wonderful things, we shall not bear them: thou didst come down, and at thy presence the mountains melted away.
texts.ESV:
When you did awesome things that we did not look for,
    you came down, the mountains quaked at your presence.

texts.NIV84: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.
texts.KJV: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
texts.NASB95:
For from days of old they have not heard or perceived by ear,
Nor has the eye seen a God besides You,
Who acts in behalf of the one who waits for Him.
texts.NKJV:
For since the beginning of the world
Men have not heard nor perceived by the ear,
Nor has the eye seen any God besides You,
Who acts for the one who waits for Him.
texts.DRB: From the beginning of the world they have not heard, nor perceived with the ears: the eye hath not seen, O God, besides thee, what things thou hast prepared for them that wait for thee.
texts.ESV:
From of old no one has heard
    or perceived by the ear,
no eye has seen a God besides you,
    who acts for those who wait for him.

texts.NIV84: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?
texts.KJV: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
texts.NASB95:
You meet him who rejoices in doing righteousness,
Who remembers You in Your ways.
Behold, You were angry, for we sinned,
We continued in them a long time;
And shall we be saved?
texts.NKJV:
You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness,
Who remembers You in Your ways.
You are indeed angry, for we have sinned—
In these ways we continue;
And we need to be saved.
texts.DRB: Thou hast met him that rejoiceth, and doth justice: in thy ways they shall remember thee: behold thou art angry, and we have sinned: in them we have been always, and we shall be saved.
texts.ESV:
You meet him who joyfully works righteousness,
    those who remember you in your ways.
Behold, you were angry, and we sinned;
    in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be saved?

texts.NIV84: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.
texts.KJV: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
texts.NASB95:
For all of us have become like one who is unclean,
And all our righteous deeds are like a filthy garment;
And all of us wither like a leaf,
And our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
texts.NKJV:
But we are all like an unclean thing,
And all our righteousnesses are like filthy rags;
We all fade as a leaf,
And our iniquities, like the wind,
Have taken us away.
texts.DRB: And we are all become as one unclean, and all our justices as the rag of a menstruous woman: and we have all fallen as a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
texts.ESV:
We have all become like one who is unclean,
    and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment.
We all fade like a leaf,
    and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

texts.NIV84: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and made us waste away because of our sins.
texts.KJV: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
texts.NASB95:
There is no one who calls on Your name,
Who arouses himself to take hold of You;
For You have hidden Your face from us
And have delivered us into the power of our iniquities.
texts.NKJV:
And there is no one who calls on Your name,
Who stirs himself up to take hold of You;
For You have hidden Your face from us,
And have consumed us because of our iniquities.
texts.DRB: There is none that calleth upon thy name: that riseth up, and taketh hold of thee: thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast crushed us in the hand of our iniquity.

texts.NIV84: Yet, O LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.
texts.KJV: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
texts.DRB: And now, O Lord, thou art our father, and we are clay: and thou art our maker, and we all are the works of thy hands.

texts.NIV84: Do not be angry beyond measure, O LORD; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray, for we are all your people.
texts.KJV: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
texts.DRB: Be not very angry, O Lord, and remember no longer our iniquity: behold, see we are all thy people.
texts.ESV:
Be not so terribly angry, O Lord,
    and remember not iniquity forever.
    Behold, please look, we are all your people.

texts.NIV84: Your sacred cities have become a desert; even Zion is a desert, Jerusalem a desolation.
texts.KJV: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
texts.NASB95:
Your holy cities have become a wilderness,
Zion has become a wilderness,
Jerusalem a desolation.
texts.NKJV:
Your holy cities are a wilderness,
Zion is a wilderness,
Jerusalem a desolation.
texts.DRB: The city of thy sanctuary is become a desert, Sion is made a desert, Jerusalem is desolate.

texts.NIV84: Our holy and glorious temple, where our fathers praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.
texts.KJV: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
texts.NASB95:
Our holy and beautiful house,
Where our fathers praised You,
Has been burned by fire;
And all our precious things have become a ruin.
texts.NKJV:
Our holy and beautiful temple,
Where our fathers praised You,
Is burned up with fire;
And all our pleasant things are laid waste.
texts.DRB: The house of our holiness, and of our glory, where our fathers praised thee, is burnt with fire, and all our lovely things are turned into ruins.
texts.ESV:
Our holy and beautiful house,
    where our fathers praised you,
has been burned by fire,
    and all our pleasant places have become ruins.

texts.NIV84: After all this, O LORD, will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?
texts.KJV: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
texts.NASB95:
Will You restrain Yourself at these things, O Lord?
Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
texts.NKJV:
Will You restrain Yourself because of these things, O Lord?
Will You hold Your peace, and afflict us very severely?
texts.DRB: Wilt thou refrain thyself, O Lord, upon these things, wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us vehemently?
texts.ESV:
Will you restrain yourself at these things, O Lord?
    Will you keep silent, and afflict us so terribly?

texts.NIV84: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
texts.KJV: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
texts.NASB95: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river of Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God to seek from Him a safe journey for us, our little ones, and all our possessions.
texts.NKJV: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river of Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from Him the right way for us and our little ones and all our possessions.
texts.DRB: And I proclaimed there a fast by the river Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before the Lord our God, and might ask of him a right way for us and for our children, and for all our substance.
texts.ESV: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a safe journey for ourselves, our children, and all our goods.

texts.NIV84: I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, because we had told the king, "The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him."
texts.KJV: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
texts.NASB95: For I was ashamed to request from the king troops and horsemen to protect us from the enemy on the way, because we had said to the king, “The hand of our God is favorably disposed to all those who seek Him, but His power and His anger are against all those who forsake Him.”
texts.NKJV: For I was ashamed to request of the king an escort of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the road, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is upon all those for good who seek Him, but His power and His wrath are against all those who forsake Him.”
texts.DRB: For I was ashamed to ask the king for aid and for horsemen, to defend us from the enemy in the way: because we had said to the king: The hand of our God is upon all them that seek him in goodness: and his power and strength, and wrath upon all them that forsake him.
texts.ESV: For I was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers and horsemen to protect us against the enemy on our way, since we had told the king, “The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him, and the power of his wrath is against all who forsake him.”

texts.NIV84: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.
texts.KJV: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
texts.NASB95: So we fasted and sought our God concerning this matter, and He listened to our entreaty.
texts.NKJV: So we fasted and entreated our God for this, and He answered our prayer.
texts.DRB: And we fasted, and besought our God for this: and it fell out prosperously unto us.
texts.ESV: So we fasted and implored our God for this, and he listened to our entreaty.

texts.NIV84: The words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
texts.KJV: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
texts.NASB95:
The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah.
Now it happened in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in Susa the capitol,
texts.NKJV:
The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah.
It came to pass in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the citadel,
texts.DRB: The words of Nehemias the son of Helchias. And it came to pass in the month of Casleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in the castle of Susa,
texts.ESV:
The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah.
Now it happened in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the citadel,

texts.NIV84: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.
texts.KJV: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
texts.NASB95: that Hanani, one of my brothers, and some men from Judah came; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped and had survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem.
texts.NKJV: that Hanani one of my brethren came with men from Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped, who had survived the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
texts.DRB: That Hanani one of my brethren came, he and some men of Juda; and I asked them concerning the Jews, that remained and were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
texts.ESV: that Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah. And I asked them concerning the Jews who escaped, who had survived the exile, and concerning Jerusalem.

texts.NIV84: They said to me, "Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire."
texts.KJV: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
texts.NASB95: They said to me, “The remnant there in the province who survived the captivity are in great distress and reproach, and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and its gates are burned with fire.”
texts.NKJV: And they said to me, “The survivors who are left from the captivity in the province are there in great distress and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”
texts.DRB: And they said to me: They that have remained, and are left of the captivity there in the province, are in great affliction, and reproach: and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and the gates thereof are burnt with fire.
texts.ESV: And they said to me, “The remnant there in the province who had survived the exile is in great trouble and shame. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are destroyed by fire.”

texts.NIV84: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.
texts.KJV: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
texts.NASB95: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept and mourned for days; and I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
texts.NKJV: So it was, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned for many days; I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
texts.DRB: And when I had heard these words, I sat down, and wept, and mourned for many days: and I fasted, and prayed before the face of the God of heaven.

texts.ESV: To us, O Lord, belongs open shame, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

texts.NIV84: The Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him;
texts.KJV: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
texts.NASB95: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against Him;
texts.NKJV: To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness, though we have rebelled against Him.
texts.DRB: But to thee, the Lord our God, mercy and forgiveness, for we have departed from thee:
texts.ESV: To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him

texts.NIV84: we have not obeyed the LORD our God or kept the laws he gave us through his servants the prophets.
texts.KJV: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
texts.NASB95: nor have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in His teachings which He set before us through His servants the prophets.
texts.NKJV: We have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in His laws, which He set before us by His servants the prophets.
texts.DRB: And we have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his law, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
texts.ESV: and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God by walking in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

texts.NIV84: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned away, refusing to obey you. "Therefore the curses and sworn judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against you.
texts.KJV: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
texts.NASB95: Indeed all Israel has transgressed Your law and turned aside, not obeying Your voice; so the curse has been poured out on us, along with the oath which is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, for we have sinned against Him.
texts.NKJV: Yes, all Israel has transgressed Your law, and has departed so as not to obey Your voice; therefore the curse and the oath written in the Law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against Him.
texts.DRB: And all Israel have transgressed thy law, and have turned away from hearing thy voice, and the malediction, and the curse, which is written in the book of Moses the servant of God, is fallen upon us, because we have sinned against him.
texts.ESV: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned aside, refusing to obey your voice. And the curse and oath that are written in the Law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out upon us, because we have sinned against him.

texts.NIV84: You have fulfilled the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing upon us great disaster. Under the whole heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
texts.KJV: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
texts.NASB95: Thus He has confirmed His words which He had spoken against us and against our rulers who ruled us, to bring on us great calamity; for under the whole heaven there has not been done anything like what was done to Jerusalem.
texts.NKJV: And He has confirmed His words, which He spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing upon us a great disaster; for under the whole heaven such has never been done as what has been done to Jerusalem.
texts.DRB: And he hath confirmed his words which he spoke against us, and against our princes that judged us, that he would bring in upon us a great evil, such as never was under all the heaven, according to that which hath been done in Jerusalem.
texts.ESV: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our rulers who ruled us, by bringing upon us a great calamity. For under the whole heaven there has not been done anything like what has been done against Jerusalem.

texts.NIV84: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us, yet we have not sought the favor of the LORD our God by turning from our sins and giving attention to your truth.
texts.KJV: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
texts.NASB95: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this calamity has come on us; yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our iniquity and giving attention to Your truth.
texts.NKJV: “As it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us; yet we have not made our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities and understand Your truth.
texts.DRB: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: and we entreated not thy face, O Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and think on thy truth.
texts.ESV: As it is written in the Law of Moses, all this calamity has come upon us; yet we have not entreated the favor of the Lord our God, turning from our iniquities and gaining insight by your truth.

texts.NIV84: The LORD did not hesitate to bring the disaster upon us, for the LORD our God is righteous in everything he does; yet we have not obeyed him.
texts.KJV: Therefore hath the Lord watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
texts.NASB95: Therefore the Lord has kept the calamity in store and brought it on us; for the Lord our God is righteous with respect to all His deeds which He has done, but we have not obeyed His voice.
texts.NKJV: Therefore the Lord has kept the disaster in mind, and brought it upon us; for the Lord our God is righteous in all the works which He does, though we have not obeyed His voice.
texts.DRB: And the Lord hath watched upon the evil, and hath brought it upon us: the Lord our God is just in all his works which he hath done: for we have not hearkened to his voice.
texts.ESV: Therefore the Lord has kept ready the calamity and has brought it upon us, for the Lord our God is righteous in all the works that he has done, and we have not obeyed his voice.

texts.NIV84: "Now, O Lord our God, who brought your people out of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for yourself a name that endures to this day, we have sinned, we have done wrong.
texts.KJV: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
texts.NASB95: “And now, O Lord our God, who have brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and have made a name for Yourself, as it is this day—we have sinned, we have been wicked.
texts.NKJV: And now, O Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and made Yourself a name, as it is this day—we have sinned, we have done wickedly!
texts.DRB: And now, O Lord our God, who hast brought forth thy people out of the land of Egypt with a strong hand, and hast made thee a name as at this day: we have sinned, we have committed iniquity,
texts.ESV: And now, O Lord our God, who brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have made a name for yourself, as at this day, we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

texts.NIV84: O Lord, in keeping with all your righteous acts, turn away your anger and your wrath from Jerusalem, your city, your holy hill. Our sins and the iniquities of our fathers have made Jerusalem and your people an object of scorn to all those around us.
texts.KJV: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
texts.NASB95: O Lord, in accordance with all Your righteous acts, let now Your anger and Your wrath turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people have become a reproach to all those around us.
texts.NKJV: “O Lord, according to all Your righteousness, I pray, let Your anger and Your fury be turned away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all those around us.
texts.DRB: O Lord, against all thy justice: let thy wrath and thy indignation be turned away, I beseech thee, from thy city Jerusalem, and from thy holy mountain. For by reason of our sins, and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem, and thy people are a reproach to all that are round about us.
texts.ESV: “O Lord, according to all your righteous acts, let your anger and your wrath turn away from your city Jerusalem, your holy hill, because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a byword among all who are around us.

texts.NIV84: "Now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of your servant. For your sake, O Lord, look with favor on your desolate sanctuary.
texts.KJV: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
texts.NASB95: So now, our God, listen to the prayer of Your servant and to his supplications, and for Your sake, O Lord, let Your face shine on Your desolate sanctuary.
texts.NKJV: Now therefore, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant, and his supplications, and for the Lord’s sake cause Your face to shine on Your sanctuary, which is desolate.
texts.DRB: Now therefore, O our God, hear the supplication of thy servant, and his prayers: and shew thy face upon thy sanctuary which is desolate, for thy own sake.
texts.ESV: Now therefore, O our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his pleas for mercy, and for your own sake, O Lord, make your face to shine upon your sanctuary, which is desolate.

texts.NIV84: Give ear, O God, and hear; open your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears your Name. We do not make requests of you because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.
texts.KJV: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.
texts.NASB95: O my God, incline Your ear and hear! Open Your eyes and see our desolations and the city which is called by Your name; for we are not presenting our supplications before You on account of any merits of our own, but on account of Your great compassion.
texts.NKJV: O my God, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by Your name; for we do not present our supplications before You because of our righteous deeds, but because of Your great mercies.
texts.DRB: Incline, O my God, thy ear, and hear: open thy eyes, and see our desolation, and the city upon which thy name is called: for it is not for our justifications that we present our prayers before thy face, but for the multitude of thy tender mercies.
texts.ESV: O my God, incline your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city that is called by your name. For we do not present our pleas before you because of our righteousness, but because of your great mercy.

texts.NIV84: O Lord, listen! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, hear and act! For your sake, O my God, do not delay, because your city and your people bear your Name."
texts.KJV: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
texts.NASB95: O Lord, hear! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, listen and take action! For Your own sake, O my God, do not delay, because Your city and Your people are called by Your name.”
texts.NKJV: O Lord, hear! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, listen and act! Do not delay for Your own sake, my God, for Your city and Your people are called by Your name.”
texts.DRB: O Lord, hear: O Lord, be appeased: hearken and do: delay not for thy own sake, O my God: because thy name is invocated upon thy city, and upon thy people.
texts.ESV: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive. O Lord, pay attention and act. Delay not, for your own sake, O my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

texts.KJV: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish's belly,
texts.NASB95: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the stomach of the fish,
texts.NKJV: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the fish’s belly.

texts.ESV: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the belly of the fish,

texts.NIV84: He said: "In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me. From the depths of the grave I called for help, and you listened to my cry.
texts.KJV: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
texts.NASB95:
and he said,
“I called out of my distress to the Lord,
And He answered me.
I cried for help from the depth of Sheol;
You heard my voice.
texts.NKJV:
And he said:
“I cried out to the Lord because of my affliction,
And He answered me. 
“Out of the belly of Sheol I cried,
And You heard my voice.
texts.DRB: And he said: I cried out of my affliction to the Lord, and he heard me: I cried out of the belly of hell, and thou hast heard my voice.
texts.ESV:
saying,
“I called out to the Lord, out of my distress,
    and he answered me;
out of the belly of Sheol I cried,
    and you heard my voice.

texts.NIV84: You hurled me into the deep, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.
texts.KJV: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
texts.NASB95:
“For You had cast me into the deep,
Into the heart of the seas,
And the current engulfed me.
All Your breakers and billows passed over me.
texts.NKJV:
For You cast me into the deep,
Into the heart of the seas,
And the floods surrounded me;
All Your billows and Your waves passed over me.
texts.DRB: And thou hast cast me forth into the deep in the heart of the sea, and a flood hath compassed me: all thy billows, and thy waves have passed over me.
texts.ESV:
For you cast me into the deep,
    into the heart of the seas,
    and the flood surrounded me;
all your waves and your billows
    passed over me.

texts.NIV84: I said, 'I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'
texts.KJV: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
texts.NASB95:
“So I said, ‘I have been expelled from Your sight.
Nevertheless I will look again toward Your holy temple.’
texts.NKJV:
Then I said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight;
Yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.’
texts.DRB: And I said: I am cast away out of the sight of thy eyes: but yet I shall see thy holy temple again.
texts.ESV:
Then I said, ‘I am driven away
    from your sight;
yet I shall again look
    upon your holy temple.’

texts.NIV84: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.
texts.KJV: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
texts.NASB95:
“Water encompassed me to the point of death.
The great deep engulfed me,
Weeds were wrapped around my head.
texts.DRB: The waters compassed me about even to the soul: the deep hath closed me round about, the sea hath covered my head.

texts.NIV84: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you brought my life up from the pit, O LORD my God.
texts.KJV: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.
texts.NASB95:
“I descended to the roots of the mountains.
The earth with its bars was around me forever,
But You have brought up my life from the pit, O Lord my God.
texts.DRB: I went down to the lowest parts of the mountains: the bars of the earth have shut me up for ever: and thou wilt bring up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.
texts.ESV:
at the roots of the mountains.
I went down to the land
    whose bars closed upon me forever;
yet you brought up my life from the pit,
    O Lord my God.

texts.NIV84: "When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, LORD, and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.
texts.KJV: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
texts.NASB95:
“While I was fainting away,
I remembered the Lord,
And my prayer came to You,
Into Your holy temple.
texts.NKJV:
“When my soul fainted within me,
I remembered the Lord;
And my prayer went up to You,
Into Your holy temple.
texts.DRB: When my soul was in distress within me, I remembered the Lord: that my prayer may come to thee, unto thy holy temple.
texts.ESV:
When my life was fainting away,
    I remembered the Lord,
and my prayer came to you,
    into your holy temple.

texts.NIV84: "Those who cling to worthless idols forfeit the grace that could be theirs.
texts.KJV: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
texts.NASB95:
“Those who regard vain idols
Forsake their faithfulness,
texts.NKJV:
“Those who regard worthless idols
Forsake their own Mercy.
texts.DRB: They that are vain observe vanities, forsake their own mercy.
texts.ESV:
Those who pay regard to vain idols
    forsake their hope of steadfast love.

texts.NIV84: But I, with a song of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. Salvation comes from the LORD."
texts.KJV: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.
texts.NASB95:
But I will sacrifice to You
With the voice of thanksgiving.
That which I have vowed I will pay.
Salvation is from the Lord.”
texts.NKJV:
But I will sacrifice to You
With the voice of thanksgiving;
I will pay what I have vowed.
Salvation is of the Lord.”
texts.DRB: But I with the voice of praise will sacrifice to thee: I will pay whatsoever I have vowed for my salvation to the Lord.
texts.ESV:
But I with the voice of thanksgiving
    will sacrifice to you;
what I have vowed I will pay.
    Salvation belongs to the Lord!”

texts.NASB95: Then the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah up onto the dry land.
texts.NKJV: So the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

texts.ESV: And the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out upon the dry land.

texts.NIV84: LORD, I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, O LORD. Renew them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.
texts.KJV: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
texts.NASB95:
Lord, I have heard the report about You and I fear.
O Lord, revive Your work in the midst of the years,
In the midst of the years make it known;
In wrath remember mercy.
texts.DRB: O Lord, I have heard thy hearing, and was afraid. O Lord, thy work, in the midst of the years bring it to life: In the midst of the years thou shalt make it known: when thou art angry, thou wilt remember mercy.

texts.NIV84: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.

texts.NASB95:
God comes from Teman,
And the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah.
His splendor covers the heavens,
And the earth is full of His praise.
texts.NKJV:
God came from Teman,
The Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah 
His glory covered the heavens,

He stood and measured the earth;
He looked and startled the nations.

The perpetual hills bowed.
His ways are everlasting.

I saw the tents of Cushan under distress,

I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction;

Did the Lord rage against the rivers,
Or was Your anger against the rivers,
Or was Your wrath against the sea,

On Your chariots of salvation?

Was Your anger against the rivers,
Was Your wrath against the sea,

Your chariots of salvation?

    Was your anger against the rivers,

In indignation You marched through the earth;
In anger You trampled the nations.
texts.NKJV:
You marched through the land in indignation;
You trampled the nations in anger.
texts.DRB: In thy anger thou wilt tread the earth under foot: in thy wrath thou wilt astonish the nations.
texts.ESV:
You marched through the earth in fury;
    you threshed the nations in anger.

texts.KJV: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

You went forth for the salvation of Your people,
For the salvation of Your anointed.
You struck the head of the house of the evil
To lay him open from thigh to neck. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
You went forth for the salvation of Your people,
For salvation with Your Anointed.
You struck the head from the house of the wicked,
By laying bare from foundation to neck. Selah
texts.DRB: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people: for salvation with thy Christ. Thou struckest the head of the house of the wicked: thou hast laid bare his foundation even to the neck.
texts.ESV:
You went out for the salvation of your people,
    for the salvation of your anointed.
You crushed the head of the house of the wicked,
    laying him bare from thigh to neck. Selah

texts.NIV84: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.
texts.KJV: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
texts.NASB95:
You pierced with his own spears
The head of his throngs.
They stormed in to scatter us;
Their exultation was like those
Who devour the oppressed in secret.
texts.NKJV:
You thrust through with his own arrows
The head of his villages.
They came out like a whirlwind to scatter me;
Their rejoicing was like feasting on the poor in secret.
texts.DRB: Thou hast cursed his sceptres, the head of his warriors, them that came out as a whirlwind to scatter me. Their joy was like that of him that devoureth the poor man in secret.
texts.ESV:
You pierced with his own arrows the heads of his warriors,
    who came like a whirlwind to scatter me,
    rejoicing as if to devour the poor in secret.

texts.NIV84: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.
texts.KJV: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
texts.NASB95:
You trampled on the sea with Your horses,
On the surge of many waters.
texts.NKJV:
You walked through the sea with Your horses,
Through the heap of great waters.
texts.DRB: Thou madest a way in the sea for thy horses, in the mud of many waters.
texts.ESV:
You trampled the sea with your horses,
    the surging of mighty waters.

texts.NIV84: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.
texts.KJV: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
texts.NASB95:
I heard and my inward parts trembled,
At the sound my lips quivered.
Decay enters my bones,
And in my place I tremble.
Because I must wait quietly for the day of distress,
For the people to arise who will invade us.
texts.DRB: I have heard and my bowels were troubled: my lips trembled at the voice. Let rottenness enter into my bones, and swarm under me. That I may rest in the day of tribulation: that I may go up to our people that are girded.
